transformations: Flatten each {seq,payload} envelope to its payload without dropping or reordering rows.
Replace the temporary directory suffix with sample and the messaging socket process ID with 00000. Reassemble streamed tool JSON before redacting, then split at the original chunk lengths.
preserved: Prompt and reply text, tool arguments and results, request resolutions, protocol IDs, timestamps, usage and durations.
boundary: The final CHILD_ACK delivery starts a follow-up turn; this capture ends at its requesting status, before a result. No final result or dialog request was inserted.
privacy_check: No home path, current machine hostname, .local/.lan hostname or email address occurs in the fixture. Temporary directory and socket identifiers are replaced.
replacement: A replacement capture comes from a fresh run of the harness into a new evidence directory (it refuses an existing one) and will hold a different conversation; adopt it by re-deriving the fixture with the transformations above, updating every hash, row count and boundary here, and reviewing the spec tests that anchor on this conversation's prose.
